executiveSummary.headline: pinupbet.hn presents as a Honduras-localized 'Pin-Up Bet' sportsbook/casino claiming a Curaçao licence; direct site and register access was blocked in this environment, and the parent 'Pin-Up' brand network carries serious unresolved sanctions history in Ukraine.
executiveSummary.narrative: pinupbet.hn was submitted as a suspected illegal gambling site targeting Honduras. Direct fetch of the target site, of a general WHOIS lookup service, and of the Curaçao Gaming Control Board's public licence register were all blocked at the network-egress level of the investigating environment for this run, so no finding below rests on a primary-source page load; everything is drawn from public web search of secondary and marketing sources. Search results consistently describe pinupbet.hn as a Spanish-language, Honduras-targeted instance of the international 'Pin-Up' betting/casino brand, operated (per Pin-Up's own regional licence-information pages, replicated near-identically across many country-specific Pin-Up sites) by Carletta N.V. of Willemstad, Curaçao under Curaçao Gaming Control Board licence OGL/2024/580/0570. At least three other near-identical '.hn' domains (pinup-bet.hn, pinupcasino.hn, pinup-casino.hn) carry the same branding, consistent with the brand's known pattern of many country- and mirror-specific domains, though none was confirmed to be operated by the identical legal entity. Honduras currently has no dedicated online-gambling licensing regime under its 1977 casino law, though one 2026 secondary source claims roughly five operators already hold some form of online authorisation; this claim could not be corroborated against a primary Honduran regulator source, and pinupbet.hn was not identified as one of them. Separately, investigative reporting (OCCRP) and Ukrainian authorities have publicly linked the broader international 'Pin-Up' brand and its identified ultimate ownership (Guruflow Team Limited, Cyprus; named beneficial owner Dmitriy Punin) to sanctions over alleged financial support to Russia's invasion of Ukraine — a serious signal at the brand level that is not independently confirmed to implicate the specific Curaçao licensee (Carletta N.V.) claimed for this Honduras-facing property.
keyFindings: Direct fetch of pinupbet.hn, of a WHOIS lookup service, and of the Curaçao Gaming Control Board's public licence register all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED from the investigating environment during this run; no finding here is based on a directly loaded primary page.

Secondary/marketing sources consistently name the operator as Carletta N.V. (Willemstad, Curaçao; business registration number 142346) under Curaçao Gaming Control Board licence OGL/2024/580/0570 — this is a disclosed claim replicated across many Pin-Up regional sites, not an independently verified register entry.

At least three other near-identical '.hn' domains (pinup-bet.hn, pinupcasino.hn, pinup-casino.hn) carry the same 'Pin-Up' Honduras branding; none was confirmed to be operated by the identical legal entity to pinupbet.hn.

Honduras has no dedicated online-gambling licensing regime under its current (1977) casino law; a 2026 anteproyecto de ley to regulate online gaming remained under discussion as of May 2026. A separate, lower-quality secondary source claims roughly five operators hold some online authorisation as of June 2026, but this could not be corroborated and did not name pinupbet.hn.

The broader international 'Pin-Up' brand and its identified ultimate owners (Guruflow Team Limited, Cyprus; Dmitriy Punin) have been publicly sanctioned by Ukraine and covered by OCCRP over alleged financial links to Russia's invasion — a serious, unresolved brand-level flag not independently confirmed to implicate the Curaçao licensee claimed for this specific Honduras property.
topContradictions: All licensing and operator-entity data comes from Pin-Up's own regional marketing/licence-information pages, not from a directly loaded site page or the Curaçao register itself (both blocked from this environment), so it is disclosed, not verified.

Secondary sources conflict on Honduras's online-gambling licensing status: one describes the current law as covering only physical casinos, another claims roughly five operators are already licensed online — neither is a primary regulator source, and this domain was not named in either.

The parent 'Pin-Up' brand's sanctioned ownership network is a serious flag, but no source directly ties the disclosed Curaçao licensee (Carletta N.V.) for pinupbet.hn to the sanctioned entities beyond shared brand identity.
executiveSummary.recommendedAction: Re-run investigation with live-browser or manually-routed access to pinupbet.hn, the Curaçao Gaming Control Board register (to confirm licence OGL/2024/580/0570 and its holder), and Honduran regulator sources, since automated tooling was blocked in this environment this run. Separately verify whether Carletta N.V. is part of the same corporate structure as the Ukraine-sanctioned Pin-Up ownership network before any escalation on that basis, and confirm whether pinup-bet.hn, pinupcasino.hn and pinup-casino.hn are operated by the same entity.

news.title: Ukraine Cracks Down on Online Casino Pin-Up, Alleging it Bankrolls the Invasion
news.summary: OCCRP reports that Ukrainian authorities sanctioned entities behind the international online casino brand Pin-Up, alleging the Cyprus-based network (whose offshore foundation is described as Guruflow Team Limited, with Dmitriy Punin named as the real owner) helps fund Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and that Pin-Up was accused of operating illegally in Ukraine.

priorityAssessment.rationale: harmAndExposure is rated medium on clear country-targeting signals — a Spanish-language, Honduras-specific ccTLD (.hn) site plus at least three near-identically branded Honduras mirror domains — but no verified traffic or scale data exists for this run. consumerHarmSeverity is unknown: no complaint or fraud reports specific to this domain were found, and responsible-gaming claims on marketing pages are unverified self-disclosure. legalReachability is medium: a named offshore operator and licensing jurisdiction (Carletta N.V., Curaçao) give a plausible regulator-to-regulator referral path, but this rests on disclosed rather than register-verified data, and hosting/registrar details are entirely unknown because RDAP/WHOIS access was blocked. actorBehaviour is elevated to high on two compounding signals: a domain-proliferation pattern consistent with known Pin-Up brand practice, and the parent brand's ownership network being publicly sanctioned by Ukraine over alleged state-linked financial flows — though this second signal is not independently confirmed to implicate the specific Curaçao licensee claimed for pinupbet.hn. feasibilityAndCost is medium given an identifiable named operator and jurisdiction but complicated by the multi-domain footprint. strategicValue is medium: Pin-Up is a large, well-resourced brand already under international scrutiny, giving any confirmed action real signal value, tempered by Honduras currently lacking a dedicated online-gambling regulatory framework to anchor formal enforcement. Net: real targeting and brand-risk signals justify a medium overall priority; verified confirmation that Carletta N.V. sits within the sanctioned Pin-Up ownership structure, or of Honduras-specific consumer-harm reports, would justify escalation to high.
referralFlags: Parent brand network ('Pin-Up' / Guruflow Team Limited, Cyprus; identified ultimate owner Dmitriy Punin) publicly sanctioned by Ukraine over alleged organised financial support to Russia's invasion — not independently confirmed to implicate the disclosed Curaçao licensee (Carletta N.V.) or this specific Honduras-facing property, but warrants further scrutiny and possible cross-regulator referral before enforcement action.

dimensions.evidence: Spanish-language, Honduras-specific '.hn' domain plus at least three near-identically branded Honduras mirror domains (pinup-bet.hn, pinupcasino.hn, pinup-casino.hn) indicate deliberate targeting of the Honduran market; no verified traffic or scale metrics were available this run.

No complaint, fraud, or non-payment reports specific to this domain or brand in Honduras were found via public search; Honduras-wide fraud-complaint statistics found were general and not attributable to this operator.

analystNotes: This run's investigation was materially constrained by the environment it ran in: direct fetch of pinupbet.hn, of a WHOIS lookup service, and of the Curaçao Gaming Control Board's public register all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED from the investigating environment itself, not from the target refusing access. Every finding here is therefore built from public web-search snippets and secondary/marketing sources, several of which are Pin-Up's own regional promotional pages (e.g. canada-pinup.ca, officialpinupcasino.com) rather than independently queried registers — treat the operator identity (Carletta N.V.) and licence claim (OGL/2024/580/0570) as disclosed, not verified, until a follow-up pass with working fetch/RDAP/register access can confirm them directly. The most consequential open thread is the parent 'Pin-Up' brand's Ukraine sanctions and OCCRP reporting on its ownership network's alleged links to financing Russia's invasion: this is a serious, legitimate flag for further scrutiny, but this run could not establish whether the specific Curaçao licensee disclosed for pinupbet.hn sits within that same sanctioned ownership structure, so it has been recorded as a referral flag rather than folded into a firm conclusion. A secondary open thread is Honduras's own online-gambling regulatory status, where available secondary sources directly conflict (no online regime in force vs. roughly five operators already licensed) and neither could be corroborated against a primary regulator source from this environment.
